"""Preserve actual dated preview checks without changing their execution dates."""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
digest = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
site = json.loads((root / 'outputs/current-preview-site-check.json').read_text())
assert site['status'] in ('pass', 'passed')
assert all(digest((root / p).read_bytes()) == value for p, value in site['source_sha256'].items())
items = {
    'review-preview-export.json': 'outputs/current-preview-site-check.json',
    'review-preview-browser-pages.json': 'outputs/browser-layout/current-review-all-pages.json',
    'review-preview-browser-interactions.json': 'outputs/browser-layout/current-review-interactions.json',
    'review-preview-svg-motion.json': 'outputs/browser-layout/current-review-svg-motion.json',
    'review-preview-svg-bounds.json': 'outputs/browser-rehearsal/current-svg-bounds.json',
}
records = []
destination = root / 'docs/validation-artifacts'
for name, source in items.items():
    raw = (root / source).read_bytes()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    assert data['status'] in ('pass', 'passed')
    if 'build_info' in data:
        assert data['build_info']['revision'] == site['revision']
    if name.endswith('svg-motion.json'):
        assert data['figure_count'] == 38
        for record in data['records']:
            assert digest((root / record['source']).read_bytes()) == record['source_sha256']
    if name.endswith('svg-bounds.json'):
        assert data['figures'] == 82 and data['failures'] == 0
        for record in data['records']:
            assert digest((root / record['figure']).read_bytes()) == record['sha256']
    if name.endswith('browser-pages.json'):
        assert data['page_count'] == 256 and data['viewport_count'] == 2
        assert len(data['records']) == 512 and not data['failures'] and not data['runtime_errors']
    target = destination / name
    assert not target.exists(), target
    target.write_bytes(raw)
    assert target.read_bytes() == raw
    records.append({'source': source, 'preserved': str(target.relative_to(root)), 'sha256': digest(raw), 'original_checked_at': data.get('checked_at', data.get('checkedAt'))})

shots = []
for source, page, width, observed_at, observation in [
    ('/tmp/current-course-1.1-desktop.png', '1.1.html', 1440, '2026-10-03T10:20:05+00:00', 'Root actually viewed the screenshot: the text-to-ID figure fills the 688px reading column; its labels and adjacent explanation are readable.'),
    ('/tmp/current-course-12.5-mobile.png', '12.5.html', 390, '2026-10-03T10:20:13+00:00', 'Root actually viewed the screenshot: the waveform, frame centre tick labels and adjacent explanation are readable in the mobile layout.'),
]:
    shots.append({'page': page, 'viewport_width': width, 'original_viewed_at': observed_at, 'captured_screenshot_sha256': digest(Path(source).read_bytes()), 'observation': observation, 'scope': 'Two actual root visual samples, not human inspection of all 512 page/viewport combinations. Screenshot binaries remain ignored workspace outputs.'})

receipt = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'preserved_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'checkout_head_at_preservation': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    'preview_revision': site['revision'],
    'status': 'passed',
    'scope': 'Exact byte copies of existing, genuinely executed, dated preview checks. All recorded book, notebook, rendering code and figure identities were compared with the current working tree. This preservation is not a new build, browser run, kernel, GPU job, final technical sign-off, or published-site validation. Original execution dates and Git revision are unchanged.',
    'records': records,
    'actual_root_visual_samples': shots,
    'verification_program': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
target = destination / 'review-preview-evidence.json'
assert not target.exists()
target.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'preserved_checks': len(records), 'current_identity_scope': len(site['source_sha256']), 'actual_root_visual_samples': len(shots)}))
